normative_scenarios.required_result: bounded retry or typed failure where catchable; kernel death follows crash recovery

normative_scenarios.scenario: cancel races with committed apply result
normative_scenarios.required_result: preserve the result and resolve the receipt; late most-recent cancel is idempotent

normative_scenarios.scenario: cancel races with batch or checkpoint ACK, or next request
normative_scenarios.required_result: serialized pre-cancel ACKs precede cancel; later events drained without ACK; matching cancel ACK required before another request

normative_scenarios.scenario: cancel ACK before actual writer stop
normative_scenarios.required_result: conformance failure; ACK is not merely signal receipt

normative_scenarios.scenario: handshake timeout, partial frame, or close timeout
normative_scenarios.required_result: applicable bounded ladder without illegal req-less cancel

normative_scenarios.scenario: checkpoint lost before ACK, or crash mid-table
normative_scenarios.required_result: no unacknowledged-snapshot adoption; whole-table retry or fresh full attempt

normative_scenarios.scenario: callback failure after publication, or shutdown failure after receipt
normative_scenarios.required_result: known commit plus durable pending or cleanup error; no duplicate work

normative_scenarios.scenario: abort after ambiguous GRV publication actually committed
normative_scenarios.required_result: report the committed outcome; do not mark it unpublished

applicability.rationale: Required core/protocol result applies to initial macOS ARM64 pass; later platform/provider evidence remains separately required.

assertions: Applied ambiguous publication remains Published revision 1 on abort, with no extra commit or engine access. Shares same test evidence as EX-PUSH-008.

execution_evidence.coverage_limit: Core assertions only, not full release-case/provider/platform matrix completion.

normative_scenarios.scenario: cleanup while commit, outcome, or writers remain unresolved
normative_scenarios.required_result: preserve evidence and return `ENGINE_BUSY` or `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`

normative_scenarios.scenario: any control frame or document contains a credential canary
normative_scenarios.required_result: conformance failure

normative_scenarios.scenario: backend credentials inherited, or raw credential stderr rendered
normative_scenarios.required_result: conformance failure

normative_scenarios.scenario: malformed adapter or public error object, or new error enum
normative_scenarios.required_result: reject or map using the existing execution companion output schema

release_cases.section: Baseline, local lifecycle and canonical bytes
release_cases.procedure: Run registered scenarios with both parent and adapter adversaries on macOS ARM64 first; incrementally map selectors/assertions. Retain all-four-platform cells for later full qualification.
release_cases.required_result: Exact named selectors and assertions mapped; no unexplained skip, parser crash, invented capability or result-schema exception. Include cross-language Arrow V5 golden fixtures.

release_cases.section: Baseline, local lifecycle and canonical bytes
release_cases.procedure: Initialize, repeat initialization, inspect a damaged root, then run packaged list/capabilities/install and fixture-command conformance.
release_cases.required_result: Idempotent configuration, damaged-root refusal, manifest listing starts no child, deterministic shadowing, protected directory/tarball installation and explicit replacement. Fixture stays outside release bundle.

release_cases.section: Baseline, local lifecycle and canonical bytes
release_cases.procedure: Capture a multi-table DuckDB snapshot with populated/empty tables, publish, repeat with a new attempt and inspect/full-verify.
release_cases.required_result: One atomic complete revision, exact data and empty completion, unchanged snapshot gives the specified no-op, correct committed history and schema-valid JSON.

release_cases.section: Baseline, local lifecycle and canonical bytes
release_cases.procedure: Change rows, remove a partition, explicitly drop a table and exercise stale-base publication.
release_cases.required_result: Only complete successful snapshots authorize omissions; exact next state, guarded base conflict and no partial publication.

release_cases.section: Baseline, local lifecycle and canonical bytes
release_cases.procedure: Remove source/adapter/declaration after accepted capture and after terminal publication; retry original and changed requests.
release_cases.required_result: Accepted capture publishes without source access; terminal replay is immutable; changed request gives `REQUEST_MISMATCH`; missing/corrupt accepted evidence is refused.

release_cases.section: Baseline, local lifecycle and canonical bytes
release_cases.procedure: Write the fixed canonical multiset through differing batch, spill, merge and file boundaries.
release_cases.required_result: Identical versioned Parquet bytes and file identities on all platforms, with duplicates/nulls/float bits preserved. A writer-profile change is explicit, not silently accepted as equivalent bytes.

release_cases.section: Baseline, local lifecycle and canonical bytes
release_cases.procedure: Run scalar/boundary/evolution fixtures through actual native extraction, canonical writing and ordinary DuckDB reads.
release_cases.required_result: Exact values/schema/order and typed null widening; lossy decimal/timestamp conversion fails before acceptance/allocation. Empty tables retain their contract.

release_cases.section: Baseline, local lifecycle and canonical bytes
release_cases.procedure: Throttle the sink, exhaust four credits, exceed source/scratch limits and fail a spill/write under supported harness resource offers.
release_cases.required_result: Bounded queues and allocations, responsive control/cancel, explicit resource failure and stopped workers. Record configured bounds plus allocator/native accounting; RSS alone is not the budget oracle.

release_cases.procedure: Create a control object, repeat create, conditional update, stale update, read, ranged read, list and idempotent delete.
release_cases.required_result: Exact conditional-write/precondition behavior, validator and size/range coherence; no fallback unconditional overwrite.

release_cases.procedure: Upload beyond one part; fail/cancel before completion and suppress a successful completion response.
release_cases.required_result: Exact successful bytes/hash; ambiguous effect is resolved by the prescribed identity proof or stays unknown. Own pending uploads are accounted for and cleaned.

release_cases.procedure: Repeat multi-table DuckDB and Salesforce capture/publication/no-op/source-free replay into S.
release_cases.required_result: Real production CLI/adapter lifecycle, exact committed manifests and bytes; replay cannot authenticate, query or allocate again.

release_cases.procedure: Pull multi-file and empty S3 views using the independently configured reader; query with ordinary DuckDB afterward.
release_cases.required_result: Saved views use exact verified keys; no glob/list/write fallback, local pseudo-file or ambient credential substitution. Schema/row checks are identical to local pulls.

release_cases.procedure: Retag unchanged bytes, change bytes/size/validator, use special-character keys and attempt an unlisted key.
release_cases.required_result: Correct full-SHA fallback for an opaque validator mismatch; changed hash/size or unauthorized key refuses before destination mutation. No alias/double-decoding bypass.

release_cases.procedure: Refresh views with a failing late table/check, then a successful new revision; prune sources and replay old receipts.
release_cases.required_result: Full rollback including ownership/checkpoints/receipts, successful new generation, immutable old receipt replay without S3/auth/reader config. Lost receipt metadata refuses.

release_cases.procedure: Read/list/head/hash/full-verify the existing G-read fixture and compare its three rows and empty table.
release_cases.required_result: Zero cloud mutations; metadata, generation, file hashes/footer and declared rows agree with the independent oracle.

release_cases.procedure: In G, test create-if-absent, generation-matched update, stale update, delete and listing.
release_cases.required_result: Correct real GCS generation preconditions and durable read-back, with no unconditional replacement. Write scope now authorized; named live harness and cleanup evidence required.

release_cases.procedure: In G, cross an upload chunk boundary, cancel/fail an upload and suppress a successful conditional-write response.
release_cases.required_result: Exact bytes, bounded streaming and specified ambiguous-outcome proof; own resumable state/effects identified and cleaned. Write scope now authorized; named live harness and cleanup evidence required.

release_cases.procedure: Repeat multi-table DuckDB and Salesforce capture/publication/no-op, verified local pulls, managed/external fixed-input builds and source-free replay in G.
release_cases.required_result: Same complete lifecycle/oracles as L/S. GCS inputs materialize as verified local files; no unadvertised GCS-view capability is required. Write scope now authorized; named live harness and cleanup evidence required.

release_cases.procedure: Pure validation/offline lookup, then real authentication against the explicitly expected org. Try a wrong expected identity and an unsupported pull declaration.
release_cases.required_result: Pure operations make no auth/HTTP call; exact org match precedes run/request fixing. Wrong org and unsupported mode refuse without query/job/publication.

release_cases.procedure: Run `auto`, explicit REST and eligible Bulk against the fixed read fixture.
release_cases.required_result: API v66.0 default, REST-first auto, independently verified identical representable values; explicit authoring and resolved transport remain separate.

release_cases.procedure: Cross real REST query locators and Bulk result pages with a slow consumer and explicit empty selection.
release_cases.required_result: Complete counts/values, durable mandatory checkpoint before any rows or empty completion, budgets enforced, no dropped/duplicate pages.

release_cases.procedure: Exercise exact decimals/timestamps, null versus empty text, formulas, functions, relationship/filter semantics and ambiguous case names.
release_cases.required_result: Existing supported filter/conversion contract preserved. Bulk is eligible only where representations are proved lossless; precise refusal replaces blanket field/function bans.

release_cases.procedure: With the fixture's reviewed mutation procedure, make a row stop matching, change a partition and then query an empty snapshot.
release_cases.required_result: New complete snapshots remove the intended rows/partitions. A failed page/object never authorizes omission. Mutation and reset run against the disposable org per the fixture procedure. Storage is not a readiness blocker; use the reviewed `--ignore-storage-limit` reset flag and prove mutation/reset and cleanup in the case harness.

release_cases.procedure: Persist Bulk creation intent, perform one real POST, suppress its response and restart.
release_cases.required_result: Durable `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, possibly empty job IDs, exactly one POST and no inferred job adoption. Private out-of-band job cleanup evidence does not authorize restarting acquisition.

release_cases.procedure: Fail/cancel after an acknowledged REST/Bulk page; test unavailable authentication using isolated harness state, without revoking existing credentials.
release_cases.required_result: No partial capture acceptance and no re-query/repeated creation under that attempt. Fresh attempt reacquires all tables. Helpers/descendants stop and diagnostics remain sanitized.

release_cases.procedure: Publish an accepted capture, then remove source/auth/helper access and retry into L, S and G.
release_cases.required_result: Original outcome or accepted-capture publication without Describe/query/auth calls; G portion is authorized under the isolated write root and still needs lifecycle evidence.

release_cases.procedure: Pull complete identity replacements from L/S/G to local DuckDB, using latest and fixed revisions; change mappings and attempt overlapping ownership.
release_cases.required_result: Stable scope and target names, atomic obsolete-target removal, exact data/checkpoints, overlap refusal and no generated historical schemas.

release_cases.procedure: Import selected partitions/old schemas with an unavailable unrelated partition and typed appended-column cases.
release_cases.required_result: Only selected manifest files read, Hive inference disabled, actual historical schema preserved and unavailable selected data refused before mutation.

release_cases.procedure: Append SQL with existing business IDs, duplicate inputs/window selection, multiple outputs, zero rows and a fresh versus repeated attempt.
release_cases.required_result: Declared SQL alone decides business policy; every query sees one pre-write state; same attempt never repeats insertions and fresh attempt re-evaluates.

release_cases.procedure: Fail the second table/check and terminate at the destination transaction commit boundary.
release_cases.required_result: All rows/schema/ownership/checkpoints/receipt changes roll back, or the immutable committed receipt is recovered. No assumed rollback of an unresolved commit.

release_cases.procedure: Run prohibited DML/multi-statements/external reads and nested view/macro/rebind/custom-callback canaries.
release_cases.required_result: Initial and automatic rebind are guarded before side-effecting callbacks; no output writes or hidden input/provenance.

release_cases.procedure: Advance with a newer pull, prune the old source, remove credentials/private state, then replay the original attempt and delete its receipt store.
release_cases.required_result: Original immutable receipt survives checkpoint advancement/pruning; changed request refuses. Lost initialized history is `PROTOCOL_FAILURE` or `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, never a fresh workspace.

release_cases.procedure: Discover inputs; attempt foreign-root/application-import inputs and direct/transitive target cycles.
release_cases.required_result: Reject before run/hold/output execution with exact provenance/cycle evidence. Discovery transaction remains fixed through run creation, holds and verification.

release_cases.procedure: Prepare against L/S/G, refresh/edit tracking tables, run source GC and invoke later.
release_cases.required_result: Exact held immutable input revision/file set used. Hold confirmation wins safely or preparation fails; edited/refreshed cached rows never substitute.

release_cases.procedure: Exercise self-base, held/dropped outputs, genuinely empty outputs, incomplete seeded outputs and omission-only completion.
release_cases.required_result: No self-hold; exact selected-output coverage; table existence never implies completion; omission-only changes commit according to the contract.

release_cases.procedure: Fail the second managed output or lose owner while its native work is active.
release_cases.required_result: No successful complete candidate, new allocation or publication; cancel and wait for workers/connections. No automatic SQL rerun in the attempt.

release_cases.procedure: Use the real external-driver library, a live native process and descendant; renew while it owns the database.
release_cases.required_result: Canonical engine/session locks retained; renewal does not open the engine; all invocation connections and descendants stop before completion. Escaped live ownership remains busy.

release_cases.procedure: Supply mismatched completion identities/digest/mapping; lose acceptance response; remove accepted result file and retry.
release_cases.required_result: Rejection before allocation for mismatches, immutable identical acceptance/replay, fresh-process continuation without managed invocation. Explicitly naming a missing file is not equivalent to omitting the accepted result argument.

release_cases.procedure: Use multi-file/empty held S3 views and self-base; fail export after a credited batch, remove reader config/source engine, restart export and later terminal replay.
release_cases.required_result: Accepted fixed outputs export with a fresh stream without source SQL; fixed provenance and holds survive tracking refresh. Finalization requires acceptance; terminal replay opens neither adapter nor engine.

release_cases.procedure: Run the fault-boundary matrix below across destination commits, GRV publication and administration on L/S/G.
release_cases.required_result: Independent before/after snapshots, exact effect counts and stable operation/attempt/run identities prove rollback, committed replay or explicit unresolved outcome.

release_cases.procedure: Inspect pending/known outcomes, use show/renew/abort, lose ownership and restart from accepted or incomplete acquisition/export.
release_cases.required_result: Inspection is read-only; abort resolves known commits, never labels them unpublished; incomplete acquisitions never restart under the same attempt.

release_cases.procedure: Pin/unpin independent scopes, retry IDs, preview GC, race a new pin/hold with applying GC and interrupt prune cleanup.
release_cases.required_result: Preview writes nothing; protections rechecked; only committed exact tombstones authorize deletion. History/coordination/high-water marks retained; cleanup resumes the same decision.

release_cases.procedure: Recover live, expired, sealed, missing/corrupt and unproven run/claim evidence, including a remote write still unresolved.
release_cases.required_result: Valid owners remain respected; recovery never publishes/rebases/adopts working tables. Local flock is never remote stopped-writer proof. Safe waiting must be reported explicitly; any claimed later progress needs actual evidence.

release_cases.procedure: Fail an advertised post-publication hook, kill before/after private acknowledgement, remove source/backend/engine and retry.
release_cases.required_result: Known outcome persisted before hook; only fixed idempotent acknowledgement retries. No duplicate capture/build/publication. Current built-ins advertise no hook; test this generic supported lifecycle with an opt-in fixture.

release_cases.procedure: Place synthetic credential canaries in parent backend/auth stores and inherited descriptors; flood stderr and inspect public output/documents/artifacts.
release_cases.required_result: No canary in control/result/diagnostic output, no inherited backend credentials, raw helper stderr never publicly rendered. Exclude legitimate private credential stores from the artifact scan; do not claim universal detection in arbitrary dataset content.

release_cases.procedure: Break permissions/owners, substitute executable after hashing, use symlink/hardlink/path aliases and malformed frame/document/completion records.
release_cases.required_result: Protected-path refusal, exact bounded strict parsing/correlation and no mutation/secret disclosure. Installation checks use protected workspace ancestors.

release_cases.procedure: Cancel/EOF/kill with occupied credits, native work and helper descendants; race established completion with cancellation.
release_cases.required_result: ACKs freeze before cancel, stopped-work acknowledgement is real, escalation is bounded and known results survive shutdown races.

release_cases.procedure: Build a clean committed macOS ARM64 candidate with locked dependencies, strict lint/formatting and minimum Rust. Retain other-platform cells for later qualification.
release_cases.required_result: Exact source commit, toolchain/native/extension hashes and capability inventory; every applicable automated case passes, including test helpers that use a custom harness.

release_cases.procedure: Package release-profile artifacts; relocate them onto clean matching hosts without the build tree/extension cache; install from directory/tarball and run representative live lifecycles.
release_cases.required_result: All three executables work; packaged native guard and signed extensions load, no hidden source-tree path or network INSTALL dependency. Never distribute the fixture adapter.

release_cases.procedure: Inventory exact Rust and native/extension dependencies, licenses and signed artifacts; verify checksums/signatures and provenance.
release_cases.required_result: Complete notices for the actual shipped bytes on each platform. Project MIT licenses or binary version strings alone do not close the native third-party gate.

release_cases.procedure: Open the pre-release development bundle's existing storage, pull receipt and accepted/terminal attempt fixtures with the candidate, then repeat supported workflows and replay.
release_cases.required_result: Contract-compatible data/replay or an explicit documented migration/refusal. No silent history reset. This is the first-release compatibility baseline; retain it for the next release's upgrade tests.

execution_scope.mapping_policy: incremental reviewed exact selectors and assertions alongside execution
